integrity: The optimum is certified directly from the channel definition by a 70-word code and a matching 70-color upper certificate, and is independently recomputed by an exact branch-and-bound search.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary length 7 with exactly one deletion per read and two distinct reads; no formula for other lengths and no classification of all optima. A poorly indexed prior finite computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact two-read single-deletion reconstruction optimum at binary length \(7\)
